product_one_liner.value: Wellinks provides health plans, providers, and health systems virtual COPD care that combines remote patient monitoring, pulmonary rehabilitation, and care-management support.
product_one_liner.notes: Wellinks describes its offering as virtual COPD care for health plans, providers, and health systems, combining remote monitoring, pulmonary rehabilitation, and care-management support.

pricing_page.notes: The homepage navigation and footer list solution, audience, resources, company, careers, news, legal, and contact links, but no pricing page. The contact page says its form is for healthcare organizations, partners, and business inquiries.

value: Highmark Blue Cross Blue Shield Delaware
named_customers.notes: named_customers: The Highmark announcement describes an agreement to deliver COPD care to its members. Wellinks’ UMass Memorial announcement says its COPD program would be available to UMMH patients and integrated across the system. | named_customers.0: The Wellinks–Highmark agreement provides virtual COPD care to Highmark Delaware members. | named_customers.1: Wellinks says its COPD disease-management program would be available to UMass Memorial Health patients and integrated across its system.

employee_band.notes: The company profile reports 29 employees, and LinkedIn lists 31 employees with a company-size range of 11–50; these support the 21–50 band. A separate workforce estimate reports approximately 102, so the conflicting estimate lowers confidence.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: Wellinks states that it is headquartered in New Haven, Connecticut; the city property is New Haven. | hq_country: Wellinks identifies its headquarters as New Haven, Connecticut. Connecticut is in the United States.

founded_year.notes: Wellinks’ company announcement states that it was founded in 2012.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index shows patient-care and industry/news material, not at least two engineer-authored posts about how the product is built; it does not present an engineering or technical blog under the stated criteria.

public_docs.notes: Wellinks makes multiple product-help articles publicly readable, including spirometry, app action plans, and Bluetooth troubleshooting, meeting the several-article help-content threshold.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The careers board lists one role, Senior Data and BI Analyst. That title is not an AI, ML, or data-science role under the stated criteria.

model_provider.notes: Wellinks’ product and blog pages describe proprietary algorithms, predictive analytics, AI, and machine learning, but name no model or provider. The reviewed product-help and privacy/legal pages disclose no provider or subprocessor list, so the provider remains unknown.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: The Wellinks blog-index footer displays a certified SOC 2 seal. Its HIPAA notice says health information is handled in compliance with HIPAA. These are the listed standards publicly named in the reviewed badge and legal materials. | compliance_certs.0: The Wellinks footer badge explicitly says “certified SOC 2.” | compliance_certs.1: Wellinks’ HIPAA notice says the handling of health information is in compliance with HIPAA; the company names HIPAA as a compliance framework.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The company announcement identifies the round as a Series B, and the company profile marks it as the latest funding round. | funding_date: The funding announcement is dated August 4, 2026, and the structured company profile confirms the latest round date; the requested YYYY-MM date is 2026-08. | funding_amount_usd: Wellinks’ August 4, 2026 announcement states that its Series B first close secured $10 million; the company profile also identifies that as the latest round amount.

raised_18mo.notes: Wellinks announced its $10 million Series B first close on August 4, 2026, within the 18 months before November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The careers board lists only a Senior Data and BI Analyst role, not an SDR, BDR, sales/business-development representative, or account executive role.

launched_6mo.notes: The company’s LinkedIn feed includes a recent “Health Tags are here!” post marked “3w,” describing a new shipment of Health Tags. This reads as an announcement of product availability within the six-month window, though the feed gives only a relative date and the post is shipment-oriented.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The August 31, 2026 announcement describes VP-level appointments or promotions for Stephanie Solich, Stephanie Willard, and Andrew Brimer. This is within the 12 months before November 9, 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The readable job posting names analytics tools such as SQL, dbt, Power BI, Snowflake, and Redshift, but no CRM or sales/marketing platform. The reviewed product-help content names none either.
